items.text: Bid compliance: assemble the proposal as a single PDF of at most 20 pages and submit it through the College's procurement portal by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC, and ensure the service is live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment, integrating with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.
items.basis: The instructions specify the format, page limit, deadline, go-live date, and API integration requirement. The order of submission is an assumption to ensure compliance.

items.text: Audit and document management: keep an audit record of every signature event, including the signer's identity, the time, and the document version, and store signed documents for ten years.
items.basis: The audit record details and the ten-year storage duration are explicitly stated. The underlying storage medium is an assumption.

items.text: Signing accessibility and notifications: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers, and send a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.
items.basis: Browser compatibility and the 72-hour reminder timeframe are explicitly stated. The reminder delivery channel is an assumption.

items.text: Service availability: maintain service availability of 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
items.basis: The availability percentage and planned maintenance notice period are explicitly stated.

questions.text: Should the supplier provide templates for the College's twelve most used forms, and how are these templates specified?
What is the expected data volume for migrating the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28?
Is the optional on-premises deployment option required to be priced separately, and what are the infrastructure prerequisites?
What support channels and escalation paths are expected for responding to severity-one incidents within one hour at any time of day?
